title: The Observatory Heist
summary: During a violent thunderstorm, a priceless sapphire was stolen from the locked observatory vault. The detective must interrogate the staff, examine clues, and find the culprit before the storm ends.

scenes.title: Observatory Entrance
scenes.description: Rain lashes against the grand entrance. The vault door is ajar, and the sapphire is gone. The staff huddle nervously.

scenes.title: Vault Room
scenes.description: The vault interior is dark, lit only by emergency lights. The empty pedestal where the sapphire once sat is covered in dust.

scenes.title: Curator's Office
scenes.description: A cozy office filled with star charts. The curator seems anxious.

scenes.title: Assistant's Workshop
scenes.description: A cluttered workshop with tools and a half-finished telescope.

scenes.title: Rooftop Observatory
scenes.description: The storm rages above. The telescope dome is open. A figure lurks in the shadows.

characters.name: Dr. Evelyn Starling
characters.description: Elderly curator, obsessed with the sapphire's history. Known for her strict security.

characters.name: Marcus Webb
characters.description: Young, ambitious assistant. Has a background in engineering and access to all areas.

characters.name: Victor Stone
characters.description: Veteran guard, on duty during the heist. Known for his strict adherence to protocol.

characters.name: Dr. Iris Gale
characters.description: Visiting scientist studying the storm. Not officially part of staff but present that night.

items.name: Broken Lock
items.description: The vault's electronic lock is smashed, wires exposed.
items.inspectText: The lock was forced open with a heavy tool. Sparks from the storm may have shorted it.

items.name: Muddy Footprint
items.description: A large, distinct footprint near the vault entrance.
items.inspectText: The footprint has a unique tread pattern. Size 12, possibly a work boot.

items.name: Torn Cloth
items.description: A piece of blue wool fabric caught on the vault door hinge.
items.inspectText: The cloth is high-quality wool, possibly from a uniform or coat.

items.name: Empty Jewel Box
items.description: The velvet-lined box that held the sapphire.
items.inspectText: The box is empty. There's a thin layer of dust on the bottom, but the center is clean.

items.name: Spare Keys
items.description: A set of spare keys to the vault, kept in the curator's desk.
items.inspectText: All keys are accounted for except one: the master key. A recent copy might exist.

items.name: Wet Umbrella
items.description: A wet umbrella in the curator's office.
items.inspectText: The umbrella is still dripping. But the curator said she didn't go out in the storm.

items.name: Leather Gloves
items.description: A pair of leather work gloves, found in the workshop.
items.inspectText: The gloves have traces of mud and a faint chemical smell.

items.name: Toolbox
items.description: A metal toolbox with various tools.
items.inspectText: A heavy pry bar is missing from the set. The slot is empty.

items.name: Stolen Sapphire
items.description: The missing sapphire, hidden in a telescope mount.
items.inspectText: The sapphire is flawless. It matches the description perfectly.

items.name: Climbing Rope
items.description: A long rope tied to the dome's railing.
items.inspectText: The rope is new and shows signs of recent use. It leads down to the ground.

clues.title: Lock Tampered With
clues.content: The lock was forced open with a pry bar, not a key. The storm's electrical surge may have disabled the alarm.

clues.title: Large Footprint
clues.content: The footprint is size 12, consistent with the assistant's work boots.

clues.title: Wool Cloth
clues.content: The torn cloth is from a blue wool uniform, like the security guard's coat.

clues.title: Dust Pattern
clues.content: The dust in the box is undisturbed except for a clean circle exactly the size of the sapphire. It wasn't moved recently.

clues.title: Duplicate Key
clues.content: The master key is missing. The assistant recently asked the curator for access to make a copy for 'emergency'.

clues.title: Umbrella Contradiction
clues.content: The curator claimed she didn't go out, but her umbrella is wet. She must have lied.

clues.title: Muddy Gloves
clues.content: The gloves have mud matching the footprint's mud. They also have traces of metal shavings.

clues.title: Missing Pry Bar
clues.content: A heavy pry bar is missing from the assistant's toolbox. It could have been used to break the lock.

clues.title: Sapphire Recovered
clues.content: The sapphire was hidden in the telescope mount on the rooftop. Only someone with knowledge of the observatory would know that spot.

clues.title: Rope Used
clues.content: The rope is tied to the dome railing and shows signs of recent climbing. The thief escaped via the roof during the storm.

clues.title: Assistant's Motive
clues.content: The assistant had gambling debts and needed money. He was overheard arguing with the curator about a loan.

clues.title: Security Alibi
clues.content: The security guard was checking the perimeter when the alarm went off. His log shows he was at the east gate at the time of the heist.

dialogues.question: What happened?
dialogues.answer: I was in my office reviewing star charts. I heard a loud crash during the thunder, then the alarm. When I got here, the vault was open and the sapphire was gone.

dialogues.question: Where were you?
dialogues.answer: I was in the workshop, working on a telescope. I didn't hear anything unusual until the alarm.

dialogues.question: What did you see?
dialogues.answer: I was on patrol. The storm knocked out power briefly. When I came back, the vault door was open. I saw a shadow on the roof, but it was gone.

dialogues.question: Why is your umbrella wet?
dialogues.answer: I... I stepped outside briefly to check the storm. It's nothing.

dialogues.question: Tell me about your debts.
dialogues.answer: I had some financial trouble, but I was managing. The curator refused to help. I didn't steal the sapphire!

dialogues.question: The rope on the roof?
dialogues.answer: I didn't put it there. It must have been the thief. I was on the ground all night.

dialogues.question: The sapphire was in your telescope mount!
dialogues.answer: I... I found it and hid it for safekeeping. I was going to return it!

finalLogic.motive: Gambling debts and resentment towards the curator for refusing a loan.
finalLogic.method: Used a duplicate key (from earlier copying) to unlock the vault during the storm. Used a pry bar from his toolbox to break the lock when the electronic system failed. Hid the sapphire in the telescope mount and escaped via rope from the roof.
finalLogic.winEnding: You confront Marcus with the evidence. He confesses, and the sapphire is returned. Justice prevails.
finalLogic.failEnding: Without enough evidence, the culprit escapes in the storm. The sapphire is lost forever.
